scope: Engineering regression on four previously exposed archived requests; no prospective evaluation, new model/provider calls, or installed-native execution.
trust_limitations: Caller transport is trusted for actual bytes and source-response association; captured response SHA is observed, not compared to an independently trusted provider receipt.
All native metric evidence in this test is explicitly historical replay or synthetic fault input; no installed MetricRunner was imported or executed.
